palette.notes: Measured 10-31 colours per sheet: smoke 10, explosion 12, electric 14, wind 15, fire 16, water 21, holograms 28, glitch 31 (UI included). Effects stay on short ramps; holograms use a 14-colour blue ramp, glitch adds noise colours.

lighting: Effects are the light: fire and explosion go white-yellow core to orange to dark red smoke, electricity is a white-cyan bolt with a flash, holograms glow blue with scanlines.
silhouette: Each effect has a clear outer shape: a teardrop flame, a round blast that breaks into rings, a tornado funnel, a zigzag bolt, a ghost body that fades to transparent at the edges.

motion.timing: Fire 30 frames at 100 ms, smoke 40 at 100 ms, water 32 at 100 ms, holograms 48 at 100 ms; explosion 20 at 80 ms (1.6 s); electric 15 at 80-110 ms; wind 80 frames and glitch 14 frames both at 60 ms, the fastest sheets.

texture: Clusters and pixel particles instead of dithering (about 1-1.8%); smoke breaks into small blobs, water into foam bits, glitch into rows of displaced pixels and noise blocks.
camera: Static panels; the explosion and electric sheets use a short white contrast frame on the whole panel to punch the moment.

acting.enters: Effects arrive with anticipation: a dark dot or flash before the blast, a spark before the bolt, a puff before the wind gust.
acting.acts: Fire layers several flame waves; the explosion goes flash, fireball, smoke, debris; wind wraps a figure in streaks; ghosts float with a slow bob while their edges flicker.
acting.exits: Effects dissipate rather than cut: smoke thins into particles, blast debris falls and stays briefly, the bolt leaves a fading afterglow, glitch snaps back to clean.
acting.depth: Effects sit in front of or behind characters to stage depth; a tiny runner in the wind panel is dwarfed by large tornado funnels.

techniques: explosion = flash frame, white circle, fireball, smoke rings, falling debris
fire as several overlapping waves cycling up and breaking off at the tip
smoke: round blobs that grow, drift and break into small particles
lightning: 1-2 frame white-cyan bolt plus a contrast frame, then afterglow
wind: thin streaks and leaves on arcs, played fast at 60 ms
hologram: blue ramp, scanlines, flicker and a row offset now and then
glitch: shifted rows, noise blocks and colour-split for 1-2 frames, then clean
every effect ends by dissipating, never by a hard cut
feel: flash before + short hot-to-cool ramp + particles that dissipate = effects that punch for 1 frame and fade for 10
for_fred: Use effects to carry Fred's exits and returns: a puff of smoke or a glitch burst when he leaves, a bubble or spark flash when he pops back. Keep each effect to a flash plus a few dissipating particles at 60-80 ms so it reads in a vertical reel, and do not repeat the same effect for every exit.
